question: Three of the following letter-clusters are alike in some manner and hence form a group. Which letter-cluster does not belong to that group?
solution:
According to the English alphabets & their positional values:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a7d12502c2ca7d9724c6b72807e815218baf7d8f4c343b106b5314067691645b.png] 

The pattern followed is:

First and third alphabet are of opposite positional values.

Second alphabet is decreased by 8 to form fourth alphabet.

Now we apply the pattern on the given options:

Option 1) [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/42c19bc3208f385507350ffdb6c7e8e7c502ceb346e087a17c2ba59b0fe19e9e.png]

Option 3) [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/35000b6800cb1880ae3ed71bf74a953ee3ba25f9dd3b77fabdde5485c47360d1.png] 

Option 4) [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1678e7c622a1cd2a84f04a256181361c837d07bd0c3a8ade004a7c122642bcd9.png]
